verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini assistant is documented as able to act on many emails at once, such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels. Filters also apply label and forward actions automatically to matching messages, which supports rule-based actions across many items. The evidence is a single brief mention, with no detail on the scale, scope or limits of these bulk actions. Missing for 10: documented batch API operations (e.g. bulk modify or delete endpoints), select-all bulk actions in the UI, limits and scale of bulk changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
When a message matches, filters automatically trigger actions such as adding or removing labels, or forwarding the email to a specified address.
After you search, you can use the results to set up a filter for these messages.
